topic: Cafe English: give me a latte or could I get a latte?

script.title: Rude or polite: "Give me a latte."

lines.text: It sounds a bit bossy. Could I get is friendly and still simple.
Could I get a latte, please?
Kit's tip: add please at the end. It makes almost any request softer.

script.right: Could I get a latte, please?
script.caption: Sound friendly, not bossy: use "Could I get"
